android.desc:
🌱 Leafie: AI Plant Identifier, Plant Doctor and Smart Care Tracker

Leafie is an AI-powered plant identifier, plant doctor and plant care tracker that helps you keep every houseplant, succulent, flower, herb or garden plant healthy.
You can identify plants, diagnose issues, track watering, set reminders and journal your plant’s growth in one simple plant care app. It is perfect for beginners, indoor gardeners, succulent lovers and houseplant collectors.

📸 Instant Plant Identifier and Plant Scanner

Snap a photo and identify any plant in seconds.
Leafie works as a plant identification app, plant scanner, plant recognition tool and succulent identifier. It recognizes houseplants, indoor plants, succulents, cacti, garden plants, flowers, herbs, shrubs and trees.
If you are unsure what plant you have, Leafie’s AI plant recognition tells you instantly and provides care instructions.

🌱 AI Plant Doctor and Problem Diagnosis

If you notice yellow leaves, brown spots, droopy stems or slow growth, Leafie’s AI plant health checker helps diagnose common plant problems.
The AI detects overwatering, underwatering, pests, bugs, fungal diseases, soil issues, root problems, nutrient deficiencies, sunburn, humidity problems and light stress.
Leafie also works as a plant disease identifier and gives you a simple, step-by-step treatment plan.

✏️ Plant Journal, Diary and Growth Tracker

Leafie includes a complete plant journal and growth tracker.
You can add notes, photos, watering logs, fertilizer dates, pruning events, repotting, soil changes and more.
Compare before-and-after photos, keep an organized plant collection and build your own succulent garden or indoor jungle.
It is a full plant diary app designed for people who want to track plant care over time.

💧 Smart Watering Calendar and Fertilizer Reminders

Leafie’s watering calendar helps you stay consistent with plant care.
You can get personalized watering schedules, weather-based watering predictions, individual care tasks, fertilizer reminders and routines that help prevent root rot and overwatering.
This feature is ideal for busy plant parents or beginners who need a reliable watering reminder app.

🎮 Gamified Plant Care with Rewards

Leafie makes plant care fun with a unique gamified system.
You can earn universal credits, level up your account, unlock achievements, complete weekly quizzes and keep track of progress streaks.
